attributes.title: NASW Montana and Idaho 2027 Conference: Strengthening our Foundation, Cultivating our Future
attributes.summary:
The Montana and Idaho chapters of NASW hold a joint conference, "Strengthening our Foundation, Cultivating our Future", March 4 to 6, 2027, at Delta Hotels Helena Colonial in Helena. It is in person only; Thursday is a Legislative Education and Action Day, followed by two days of sessions.

The registration page lists CE for LCSW, LMSW, LBSW, LCPC and LAC licensees: 2 hours for the Thursday pre-conference workshop, up to 6 on Friday and up to 5 on Saturday. The approving body is not named on the page.

Keynotes are given by Dr. Co Carew, an expressive arts therapist and social work professor, and Dr. Christopher Cutter of the Yale Child Study Center. Base ticket prices were not shown; full-event tickets bought before December 1, 2026 are $50 cheaper, and the hotel block at $169 a night runs until February 18, 2027.
